This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 2026-02-17 (the "Effective Date") by and between Svea Logistik
AB, with its registered office at Industrivägen 3, Göteborg ("Party A"), and Nordiska Verktyg AB, with its registered office at Industrivägen
3, Göteborg ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 12 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by Swedish law.
